configurations.name: frontend
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && exec npm run dev

configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && export ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development && export ConnectionStrings__Default="Host=localhost;Database=englishreadingdb;Username=$POSTGRES_USER;Password=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" && export Jwt__Key="$JWT_KEY" && cd EnglishReadingPlatform && exec dotnet run --no-launch-profile --urls http://0.0.0.0:5001

configurations.name: mobil
runtimeArgs: cd mobile && exec npx expo start --port 8081
